# ankra_morpheus_clouds (Data Source)

The HPE Morpheus clouds behind a credential, for `cloud_id` on `ankra_morpheus_cluster`. The counterpart of `ankra cluster morpheus clouds`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_morpheus_clouds" "all" {
  credential_id = ankra_morpheus_credential.main.id
}

output "morpheus_clouds" {
  value = { for cloud in data.ankra_morpheus_clouds.all.clouds : cloud.name => cloud.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credential_id` (String) Credential to read the catalogue through.

### Read-Only

- `clouds` (Attributes List) Clouds. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clouds))

<a id="nestedatt--clouds"></a>
### Nested Schema for `clouds`

Read-Only:

- `cloud_type` (String) Cloud type, when reported.
- `id` (Number) Cloud id.
- `name` (String) Cloud name.
